name: Leads
description: Lifecycle stages of people and organizations, automatic transitions, the lead inbox (qualify, disqualify, convert) and disqualification reasons

inbox.title: Lead inbox
inbox.description: Contacts in the Lead stage. Qualify, disqualify with a reason or convert them into a deal.

disqualify.title: Disqualify lead
disqualify.description: {{name}} leaves the lead inbox. The reason is kept in the history and the report.
disqualify.noReasons: No active reason. Add reasons in Settings > Lifecycle.
disqualify.notePlaceholder: Details for whoever checks this contact later

convert.title: Convert into a deal
convert.description: Creates a deal with {{name}} and the primary company of the contact, and moves the contact to the Opportunity stage.

history.title: Lifecycle stage history
history.description: Every stage change, who made it and how long the record stayed in each stage.
history.emptyDescription: The history starts when the lifecycle stage is set.

report.title: Lifecycle conversion
report.description: How many records entered each stage in the period, how many moved forward and how long they stayed in each one. Only records you can see are counted.
report.stagesDescription: Current = records in the stage today. Entered = records that reached the stage in the period. Conversion counts those that later reached any following stage.

rules.title: Automatic transitions
rules.description: Change the stage of the contact and the company of a deal when it is created, won or lost. A rule only changes records in the checked source stages, so it never demotes a customer unless you ask for it.
rules.fromDescription: Records in other stages stay as they are.

deal_created.label: Deal created or reopened
deal_created.description: When a deal is created (or reopened) for the contact or the company.

deal_won.label: Deal won
deal_won.description: When a deal of the contact or the company is won.

all_deals_lost.label: All deals lost
all_deals_lost.description: When the last open deal is lost or deleted and the record has no won deal.

disqualified.title: Stage of a disqualified lead
disqualified.description: Stage given to a contact disqualified in the lead inbox.

reasons.title: Disqualification reasons
reasons.description: Reasons to disqualify a lead in the lead inbox.
reasons.dialogDescription: The name shows in the disqualification and the report. The key is used by configuration packages and never changes.
reasons.name: Name
reasons.deleteDescription: Disqualifications with the reason {{name}} keep its name in the history.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.pipelineNotFound: The chosen pipeline no longer exists.
errors.notLead: This contact is no longer a lead. Reload the list.
errors.keyTaken: Another reason already uses this key.
errors.versionConflict: Someone changed these settings. Reload and try again.

quickFilter.label: Leads only
quickFilter.description: Show only people in the lead stage
